Far to the northwest lies the [[Crystal Desert]], of which these sulfurous sands had once been a part. The poisonous fumes emitted by the corrupted sands ([[Sulfurous Haze]]) is so lethal that all living creatures will die within seconds of directly inhaling these fumes. Only the [[Junundu]] wurms appear immune to the deadly gas, with exception of the colossal [[Desert Wurm]]s. ==Getting there== {{TOCright}} Head out the south exit of [[Remains of Sahlahja (outpost)|Remains of Sahlahja]] or the northwestern exit of the [[Gate of Desolation (outpost)|Gate of Desolation]]. Most of this [[explorable area]] is actually optional, as the required travel through this area is accomplished in the [[Gate of Desolation|Gate of Desolation mission]], however the primary quest temple in the southwestern corner. *[[Wurm Spoor]] ==Notes== {{gw2w|Sulfurous Wastelands}} * To reach the small northern plateau on the map, you must destroy a pillar using [[Junundu Smash]] to create a bridge (see map above). ** The pillar's base is on the southern side of the narrow east-west [[Sulfurous Haze]] path to the north. ** Junundu Smash requires adrenaline, which you can build up by fighting the [[undead]] to the east or west or by attacking the [[Margonite]]s on the north plateau from the path below. Either way, use [[Junundu Tunnel]] to quickly return to the pillar. The pillar can also be destroyed from the path below. ** [[Infantryman Hareh]], who has two [[secondary quest]]s, is on that northern plateau. *{{Vanquisher|count = 329|low = 237|high = 421}} ** There are three Margonite groups on a small northern plateau that can only be fought after smashing a pillar (see above). If you kill all available foes ''before'' knocking down the pillar, you will be unable to complete the vanquish unless you can find another way to generate the required adrenaline to power Junundu Smash. ** If you have vanquished everything nearby but have a [[minion master]] you can sacrifice party members or heroes on the sulphurous sands to generate corpses. Then sacrifice the minion master to make the minions hostile, letting you build up the adrenaline needed for Junundu Smash. [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oLWO0q5ZTgs Video]. ** Alternatively, if you have no minion master, you can equip a bow or spear and use the Junudu's ranged basic attack against the Margonite groups to build up the adrenaline needed to smash the pillar. ** [[Bohdabi the Destructive]]'s undead mob in the northwest can be hard to handle on foot. You can make use of the wurm spoor in the extreme northwest and then aggro as many monsters as you can. ** There are [[Popup|hidden]] [[Mandragor]]s towards the southwest. ** Activating [[Requiem for a Brain]] while vanquishing will spawn additional foes. * This area is a good place [[Lightbringer_rank#Acquisition|to farm Sunspear and Lightbringer points]], especially if [[A Show of Force]] and [[Requiem for a Brain]] are active. ** During an Elonian Support [[Weekly bonuses|weekly bonus]], you can max your [[Lightbringer rank|Lightbringer]] title by vanquishing the area around ten times. {{Explorable areas in the Desolation}} [[Category:Has Sunspear bounties]] [[Category:Has Lightbringer bounties]] [[de:Die Schwefel-Einöde]]
